name: planipret-mobile
description: Planiprêt — Standalone Capacitor Mobile App (iOS + Android)

scripts.postbuild: node scripts/strip-obsolete-ios-fallback.mjs && node scripts/verify-sip-bundle.mjs && node scripts/postbuild-sync.mjs
scripts.cap:add:ios: cap add ios && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs
scripts.cap:add:android: cap add android && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs
scripts.sync:ios: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap sync ios && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs && npm run verify:sip:bundle
scripts.ios:build-sync: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run precheck:build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs && npm run verify:sip:bundle
scripts.android:build-sync: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run precheck:build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && npx cap sync android && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:sip:bundle
scripts.sync:ios:fast: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap copy ios && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs && npm run verify:sip:bundle
scripts.sync:android: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap sync android && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:sip:bundle
scripts.build:ios: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run audit:parity && npm run audit:native && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap sync ios && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-ios-scene.mjs && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap open ios
scripts.build:ios:dev: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run audit:parity && vite build --mode development && cap copy ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: export PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 && npm run audit:parity && npm run audit:native && npm run check:imports && npm run build && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap sync android && node scripts/apply-native-config.mjs && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:sip:bundle && cap open android
scripts.ota:bundle: PP_SKIP_AUTOSYNC=1 npm run build && node scripts/build-ota-bundle.mjs
